title: Canonical section-module operations and normalized comparison maps
statement: For a commutative condensed ring and its pulled-back coefficients [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], reconstruct the section rings and module equivalences [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. For $f:X\to Y$, define the section-ring morphism from the actual coefficient unit [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], by its unique sectionwise formula. Define lowerStar as sectionwise sheaf-module pushforward and upperStar as the sheafified tensor pullback. Define lowerComparison as the unique identity-on-sections isomorphism from the internal direct image [def-sfb-module-lower-star] to this direct image under reconstruction. Define upperComparison as the adjunction mate, with the specified units [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]. For an open immersion, extension is the left adjoint of upperStar; openComparison is the unique mate-normalized comparison with the internal open extension [def-sfb-module-open-lower-shriek]. These definitions retain the actual site, ring and equivalence, and all canonical comparisons, rather than an arbitrary choice of functors or isomorphisms.
